title: Culture Cartography: Mapping the Landscape of Cultural Knowledge
reasoning: The paper focuses on eliciting and benchmarking cultural knowledge gaps in LLMs, which include a significant component of religious traditions (e.g., Christmas, Eid al-Fitr, Islamic culture) and social-moral norms (e.g., funeral rituals, community engagement). It specifically evaluates model performance on benchmarks like BLEnD and CulturalBench which contain religious and cultural content.
